narrative:
Shipping velocity: nothing has shipped yet. Two requests are on record, both started on 2026-11-03. One is at about 25% (tests drafted) and one at about 70% (fix and tests in place, no merge recorded), so there is no ask-to-ship time to measure.

## 2026-11-03: isSameOrigin helper for ufo

The owner asked for an `isSameOrigin(a, b)` helper in ufo. They set the order of work. First, write the test cases in a new `test/same-origin.test.ts` so the semantics can be agreed. Second, do not implement the helper yet.

The agent read the isSamePath tests and the origin handling in `src/url.ts` (obs 2). It then drafted the spec, leaving open questions as `test.todo` entries (obs 3). The owner replied that the draft looked reasonable but wanted ports kept strict: `https://example.com` and `https://example.com:443` must not match, with a case for exactly that. The agent changed the spec to compare ports literally (obs 4).

The semantics are not settled. At 07:05 the owner said, in another conversation, that default ports should now count as the same origin. The tests do not yet reflect this. The implementation is deferred, and the request sits at about 25%.

## 2026-11-03: joinURL query and hash ordering fix

The owner reported that `joinURL("/api?v=2", "users")` returned `"/api?v=2/users"` instead of `"/api/users?v=2"`, with the same defect for a `#hash`. They asked for a fix with tests. The agent traced the cause to string concatenation without parsing (obs 5) and checked the existing helpers (obs 6).

It patched `joinURL` to split off the base query and fragment before appending segments, and added regression tests. Those tests showed `joinRelativeURL` has the same defect (obs 7). The agent moved the query and hash cases into a joinURL-only loop so `joinRelativeURL` no longer inherits them. A full run showed 46 failing tests, mostly the unimplemented isSameOrigin tests (obs 8).

The owner said they were pushing the branch for the joinURL fix and told the agent not to touch the same-origin tests. No PR, merge or release is recorded. The `joinRelativeURL` defect is still open. The request sits at about 70%.

## What this shows so far

The owner wants behavior pinned down by tests and agreed before code is written. They like strict, explicit behavior over implicit normalization. They also keep unrelated work out of a branch they are about to push. The two requests overlap in the shared test suite, so the unimplemented isSameOrigin tests fail in full runs of the joinURL branch. The open items are the port semantics, the `joinRelativeURL` defect, and a merge for the joinURL fix.
